summary: P2.2 (grouped delivery) and P2.3 (merchant AI BI) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 11/11 + HTTP smoke 5/5 pass. Frontend UI confirmed for admin grouping-config card (all 5 inputs + toggle), merchant Analytics (real KPIs 196.92€/17/11.58€/Mar) and AI Insights card (real Gemini text in summary/forecast/popular/promos/stock).

ui_bugs.issue: No explicit Save button found inside the 'Livraison groupée 🌱' card. Inputs are present and editable but persistence path from UI is unclear — needs either an explicit Save button (e.g. matching the 'Enregistrer' pattern used by the SB PayGo card above) or visible debounced auto-save feedback. Backend PUT works (verified via curl + pytest), so this is purely a UX/persistence-from-UI concern.

action_items: Confirm save mechanism for the admin grouping-config card (add explicit Save button or visible auto-save indicator/test).
Optional: surface 'Grouped delivery is enabled' confirmation toast after PUT /api/orders/admin/grouping-config completes.
critical_code_review_comments: merchant_ai.py wraps AI results under {'period','insights':{...}} which differs from rule-fallback flat-shape expectations. Keep consistent unwrapping in /me/ai-insights consumers (frontend handles it, OK).
AdminPaymentMethods grouping-config-card lacks an explicit save action — relies on a different save trigger not obvious to user/tester.
Console shows several `401` from initial unauthenticated bootstrap calls before login. Harmless but noisy — consider gating those requests behind auth state.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (Admin & Merchant flows OK; only minor missing UX save button)

test_credentials: admin@superapp.com/SuperAdmin123!, merchant@example.com/Merchant123! — both work via /login/email (email/password). Phone OTP path at /login is the default; email login is at /login/email behind 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion'.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo merchant data (Resto Demo SB — revenue 196.92€).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is httpOnly-cookie based; use page.context.clear_cookies() between role switches. Email login path is /login/email; login response shape is {access_token, token_type, user}. /api/orders/delivery-options requires auth and returns {options:[...]}. /api/orders/admin/grouping-config PUT/GET works. /api/merchants/me/ai-insights returns {period, insights:{summary, forecast, popular, promos, stock_alerts, source}}. Gemini takes ~3-5s; allow ~6s wait in UI tests. The grouping batcher loop runs every ~20s; to observe a real batch, create 2 grouped orders near same area and wait. Tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_grouped_delivery.py, test_merchant_bi.py, test_p22_p23_http.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional defects detected. Only minor UX observation about the grouping-config save affordance.
